name: onboarding-api
description: The single backend for onboarding: plans, plan tasks, the standard template, department task lists and overdue reminders. It owns all records in its PostgreSQL database, copies the template into each new plan, recomputes due dates when a start date changes, works out overdue tasks at read time, and derives a task owner's department from their IT, HR or facilities group. It sends no email or chat messages and holds no UI.
